title: Kumbho
text: 2. Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kumbho nikkujjo vamateva udakaṃ no paccāvamati || evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto vamateva pāpake akusale dhamme no paccāvamati || || Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto vamateva pāpake akusale dhamme no paccāvamati || || 3. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti viveka- || la || sammāsamādhim bhaveti viveva- virāga- nirodhanisitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu a- amaggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto vamateva pāpake akusale dhamme no paccāvamatī ti || ||
